description: Intent i005 (sysctl-unbounded-knob, snapshot s01) complete. FINDING: net/ipv4/sysctl_net_ipv4.c:1279-1285 — the per-netns RFC 5961 anti-spoofing knob "tcp_challenge_ack_limit" (.data = &init_net.ipv4.sysctl_tcp_challenge_ack_limit, .maxlen = sizeof(int), mode 0644) is parsed with plain proc_dointvec and no proc_dointvec_minmax / extra1 / extra2 bounds, inside ipv4_net_table registered per-net via register_net_sysctl (line 1439). Unsafe use verified in-source at net/ipv4/tcp_input.c:3615-3619: the int is read into u32 ack_limit and used as half = (ack_limit + 1) >> 1 and challenge_count = half + prandom_u32_max(ack_limit), where prandom_u32_max (include/linux/prandom.h:94-97) is defined for ep_ro > 0; an out-of-range write (0, or negative int wrapping to huge u32) is consumed with no validation, and 0 in particular disables the challenge-ACK rate limit that the knob exists to enforce (default 1000, tcp_ipv4.c:3169). Same missing-bounds mechanism family as the seed (unvalidated parse feeding a security boolean/rate knob), though here the generic handler is used (no uninit out-param) and writes need CAP_NET_ADMIN — expressed as medium confidence. Classified candidates: randomize_va_space (kernel/sysctl.c:2473), perf_event_paranoid (2601), seg6_require_hmac (net/ipv6/addrconf.c:6917), apparmor unprivileged_userns_apparmor_policy (security/apparmor/lsm.c:1731), xfrm_larval_drop (net/xfrm/xfrm_sysctl.c:26), ipvs secure_tcp (validated 0..3), fips_enabled (read-only), sctp neighbor entries, and the minmax-guarded security knobs (dmesg_restrict/kptr_restrict/protected_*/unprivileged_*/modules_disabled/kexec_load_disabled/keys/loadpin/yama/fsverity/tipc/conntrack/bpf_jit_*/tagged_addr_disabled) = safe; urandom_min_reseed_secs (drivers/char/random.c:2106) = unresolved (unbounded int, consumers not fully traced). Limitations: keyword+handler-enumeration bounded search (186 plain proc_dointvec sites scanned, 47 in kernel/sysctl.c and 32 in net/ipv6/addrconf.c only name-triaged); no dynamic testing of the rate-limit-bypass hypothesis; snapshot s02 out of scope. Artifact written to agent-state/findings/i005.json with snapshots_checked=["s01"] and literal source quote verified against the file.
